brand.$description: The brand surface: the surface that follows the brand, such as the Arizona Header's fill. Blue by default; a theme can point it at another primary color, such as Red for the original red header. Repoint on-brand.* with it — aliases the brand palette.

default.$description: The default surface: the page background most content sits on, such as a breadcrumb's fill. Use on-default.* for what sits on it — aliases the brand palette.
Text and icons on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

border.$description: Borders and dividers on surface.brand, such as a form field's outline. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text in form fields on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

accent.$description: Accent for hover and focus on surface.brand, such as a form field's border while it has focus. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

logo.$description: Logo color on surface.brand, such as the Arizona Header's wordmark. Separate from on-brand.default because a logo's color is its own brand decision: it can't follow every change to text color. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

link.$description: Ordinary links on surface.default, such as a link in running text or an accordion's Copy link — aliases the brand palette.

link-quiet.$description: Links and controls on surface.default that are quieter than ordinary links, such as a breadcrumb's links and home icon — aliases the brand palette.

accent.$description: Accent on surface.default, such as the dividers between breadcrumb items — aliases the brand palette.

height.$description: Header height: its minimum height at every screen size, and its fixed height below 992px.

color.$description: Header fill: the brand surface, Blue by default. The original red header comes from a theme that points surface.brand at Red.
Color of the header's wordmark logo.

width.$description: Wordmark width below the sm breakpoint (576px).

height.$description: Wordmark height below the sm breakpoint (576px).

width.$description: Wordmark width from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

height.$description: Wordmark height from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

margin-left.$description: Space before the wordmark, at the header's left edge.

color.$description: Keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons, drawn inside the element's edge.

width.$description: Width of the inset keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the logo and header buttons while they have keyboard focus, so the ring has rounded corners.

color.$description: Header button text and icon color.

size.$description: Header button icon width and height: the icon is 24px square, whether it's an SVG, a sprite or a font glyph.

color.$description: Header button icon color: the same as the label, so icons and text change together. An SVG icon picks it up through fill="currentColor".

gap.$description: Space between a header button's icon and its label.

y.$description: Header button top and bottom padding.

min-height.$description: Header button minimum height: the header's own height.

duration.$description: How long a header button's colors and focus ring take to change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for a header button's color and focus ring changes. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

scroll-offset.$description: When the header is fixed on mobile (below 992px): how far below the top of the screen linked sections stop when scrolled to, so the header doesn't cover them.

duration.$description: How long the off-canvas panel (opened by the header buttons) takes to slide in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas panel's slide. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

duration.$description: How long the backdrop behind the off-canvas panel takes to fade in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas backdrop's fade. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

height.$description: Height of a text field with an attached button.

x.$description: Space between the field's left and right edges and its text.

y.$description: Space above and below the field's text.

padding.$description: Space around the attached button's icon.

size.$description: The attached button's icon width and height.

width.$description: Border width around the field and button together.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the field and button together.

width.$description: Width of the line between the field and the button: the same as the border.

duration.$description: How long the divider's color takes to change when the field gains or loses focus. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the divider's color change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

color.$description: Field text color on the brand surface.
Placeholder text color on the brand surface.
Border color on the brand surface, around the field and button.
Color of the line between the field and button on the brand surface.
The attached button's icon color on the brand surface.
The attached button's icon color on hover, on the brand surface.
Border color while the field or button has focus, on the brand surface.
Divider color while the field or button has focus, on the brand surface.

max-width.$description: Search form's maximum width. It's an input group, so its other values come from az.component.input-group.

x.$description: Space to the left and right of the search form.

y.$description: Space above and below the search form.

color.$description: Keyboard focus ring on the button that shows the search form on small screens, on the brand surface.

width.$description: Width of that button's keyboard focus ring.

color.$description: Breadcrumb's fill.

x.$description: Space to the left and right of the breadcrumb (0.609rem).

y.$description: Space above and below the breadcrumb.

margin-bottom.$description: Space below the breadcrumb, below the lg breakpoint (992px).
Space below the breadcrumb from the lg breakpoint (992px) up: none.

size.$description: Size of every item's text, linked or current.

weight.$description: Weight of every item's text, linked or current.

line-height.$description: Line height of every item's text: the same as its size.

color.$description: Linked items' text.
The current page's item, which isn't a link.
Linked items' text on hover: unchanged, so the underline shows the hover.
Underline under a linked item on hover: the same color as its text.

offset.$description: How far below the text's baseline the hover underline sits, on every item, Home included.

color.$description: The / between items.

gap.$description: Space on each side of the / between items.

color.$description: The house icon before Home: the link color, and part of the link.

size.$description: Width and height of the house icon before Home (1.2rem).

gap.$description: Space between the house icon and Home.

raise.$description: How far the house icon sits above the text's top edge, so it lines up with the text the way it does on arizona.edu.
